purpose: Frozen experimental designs that map a claim_id to a paired baseline/treatment comparison. dv_claim_experiment_gate.py refuses any request whose claim has no entry here.

design_required_fields.corpus_slices: map slice_id -> {path, sha256}; frozen corpus slices only
design_required_fields.verifier_files: list of {path, sha256}; oracle/verifier files pinned and re-checked after execution
design_required_fields.estimated_usd_per_run: map treatment_id -> positive number; pre-run estimate used for the budget gate
design_required_fields.timeouts_ms: frozen executor and run timeouts (informational until the execution adapter exists)
